plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero to eliminate high risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and free up capital.
Add SNOW to 10% as a quality AI/Software holding.
Add QQQI to 15% to increase focus on income generation.

conservative.read: This plan targets ~1.5% monthly return with a focus on capital preservation. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns compared to other modes. Significant cash buffer is maintained.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to low single digits to reduce risk.
Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and free up capital.
Add SNOW to 4% as a quality AI/Software holding.
Add CRWD to 10% to increase exposure to a strong AI/Software name.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth by trimming leverage and concentration while adding quality names.
balanced.read: This plan targets ~2.5% monthly return with a risk-first growth approach. It aims to reduce overall leverage and concentration while still participating in market upside. Drawdowns are expected to be moderate.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to capitalize on uptrends.
Trim SPY to 15% to allow for greater concentration in high-conviction names.
Add SNOW to 6% and CRWD to 10% to focus on top-scoring AI/Software setups.

Expect higher potential upside but also significantly larger drawdowns and leverage decay risks.
aggressive.read: This plan targets ~4% monthly return, aiming for aggressive growth. It leans heavily into leverage and concentrated positions, including leveraged ETFs. Expect amplified gains and losses, with potential for substantial drawdowns and margin call risk.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) and high-beta single names (CRWD, SNOW) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce volatility and free up capital.
Significantly increase QQQI to 30% to maximize focus on income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and capital preservation over growth.
Expect lower volatility and reliable income streams, though NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
income.read: This plan targets ~1% monthly return, focusing on generating steady income. It minimizes risk by cutting leverage and volatile single names, favoring income-generating ETFs. Drawdowns are expected to be minimal, but growth potential is also limited.
